decision: The Competitor (Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda) is fined €700.
event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 9 Date 24 May 2018 Time 13:03 2018 MONACO GRAND PRIX 23 - 27 May 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 10 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 60 km/h for this Event by 6.1 km/h. Nish Shetty Jose Abed Danny Sullivan Eric Barrabino
rules_referenced: Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
